record.field: Describe a model's readable fields (label, type, help, selection options and relation target) so their values can be interpreted. Returns "fields" (readable) and "hidden" (fields forbidden to AI).

Search and read records of a model. Accepts an optional Odoo domain such as [["is_company", "=", true]], an explicit field list, a limit (200 at most, and by default), an offset and an order. Without a field list, the stored fields are returned; ask for computed ones explicitly. "has_more" tells whether more records match: read the next page with the offset increased by the limit, keeping the same domain and order. Relational fields are returned as record IDs; read the related model to get the details of those records. Dates and times are in UTC. A requested field missing from the records is not available (forbidden to AI, binary, or not readable for the current user), so do not retry it; get_fields lists the readable fields, and the forbidden ones under "hidden". A field whose value cannot be computed for the current user is left out and listed in "inaccessible_fields"; do not retry it either.
